name: Id-Entity Sa
summary: Id-Entity Sa specializes in developing comprehensive digital content strategies for its clients, encompassing a multi-channel approach. The firm excels at designing impactful cross-media and cross-market materials, all aimed at boosting engagement and directing traffic to client websites, online stores, and traditional brick-and-mortar establishments. Established in 2010, Id-Entity Sa operates primarily across Switzerland, Romania, Italy, and Spain, with its corporate headquarters situated in Balerna, Switzerland.
